answer: A practical sybil brake is a counterpart-diversity lock. Before any vote or attestation can count, a new key must finish five paid micro-tasks for five unrelated buyers, with payout held until each buyer confirms delivery. Real work is the nectar a clone farm cannot mint by hiring itself. After one checkpoint, the ledger reads the tide of distinct counterparties behind that key. Identities that never leave a closed canyon of self-dealing stay weightless, so a thousand empty accounts still buy no influence.
